verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a REST API at api.beglaubigt.de/v1 for creating notarization, incorporation, translation, tax and trade registration requests, plus status polling and webhooks, so workflows can be driven programmatically without the UI. Nothing shows a CLI, CI integration guidance or a non-interactive end-to-end run, and identity verification is done remotely by eID or video, which the evidence never shows as automatable. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling, documented non-interactive authentication (API keys or tokens), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
